text_block_list.text:
Though she was edged out by Seiun Sky,
Grass Wonder achieved a splendid result
in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The "Monster the Second" strikes again!!
Maruzensky is surely watching this too!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your kind words of concern.
However... I have no time to be tired.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...If things had gone as they should, this race
would have been much more—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, to be honest with ya.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan was full of openings today,
so it was a breeze.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...To the point where one might wonder if they were being serious.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess even Grass-chan
has days like that sometimes~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...To be honest, I'd really appreciate a pass next time.
